name: Skipped Merchant Call and exact Deal association survive reload
description:
Objective: Skipped Merchant Call and the exact Deal association survive a real reload.
Preconditions: Authenticated QA user; APP-2026-000262 already has the authorized one-shot skip and Deal conversion.
Steps:
1. Open the exact application.
2. Assert DEAL_CREATED/CONVERTED_TO_DEAL/SKIPPED in its API and Deal Created in its UI.
3. Assert the single skip and conversion timeline transitions and active primary Deal reference.
4. Reload.
5. Reassert the same terminal state and same persisted reference ID.
Expected: Reload fetches the same application with one skip transition, one conversion transition, and the unchanged active primary Deal association.
